description: dsh hooks for the jiancai system. Read-only gates: never edit business code, never cross module boundaries. Code maps are split into docs/CODEMAPS (overview) and per-file @file headers.

hooks.description: Client must never contain print buttons / print wording (printing lives on the server, S12).
Same scanner, full report: prints every @UiButton / ButtonSpec so new buttons show up in review.
Warn when a Kotlin file has no @file code-map header in its first 10 lines.
